    The 2nd single from her debut album, Mariah Carey, it was added after the album is considered done, and copies of the album already pressed. So, some copies of the album does not have the song printed on the artwork. The single went to #1 on both the Hot 100 & R&B chart. The version on this promo CD is the version where the whistle note is made softer on the single, on some copies it has the "Remix" sticker on the front cover. Some copies of the debut album has this version too.

    Ripped from personal collection, if there are issues with the rip, do let me know. Thank you.
